name: PR list FINDINGS column shows severity counters and opens the findings popover
description: On the PR list, the seeded PR #482 (one review with one CRITICAL and one WARNING finding) must render a FINDINGS column between SCORE and STATUS. Hovering its trigger lists the findings themselves. The trigger is opened by HOVER, not click: it opens on onMouseEnter/onFocus and its onClick TOGGLES, so a click arriving after the driver has already focused the element closes the popover again. The header assertion matches FINDINGS in caps — the i18n string is "Findings" but the header row is text-transform: uppercase and the driver matches rendered text. Read-only seeded data (no model call). Assumes the freshly-seeded hermetic stack — see e2e/README.md.
